_readme: Beat script for the DMV appointment video, condensed from the dmv-appointment blog post and re-checked against dmv.ca.gov on 2026-10-16: the appointments page (no counter service for renewals, records, replacements; the service list; the three options after picking a service), the location and date pickers (Arleta had open times three days out), the field office wait times page (state averages about 0:10 with an appointment, 0:33 without), the DL 44 online application page, the DMV kiosk page and the DMV Now kiosks FAQ (289 kiosks, what they can and cannot do, what to bring, 1.95% card fee, languages, the 1-833-947-1670 kiosk line) and the senior drivers page. Claims the DMV does not state anywhere (30-minute grace period, 24-hour rescheduling rule, no-show blocks, 4 to 10 week lead times) are left out. Rendered as animated slides by scripts/video-pipeline/generateMotionVideo.js (layouts: title, bullets, steps, stat, image, grid, compare, flow, map, cta). `screens` are DMV screenshots captured by captureScreens.js into assets/dmv-appointment-2026/. `videoQuery` beats get a Pexels clip as a moving background (resolved into `clip`); `imageQuery` and grid `tiles` get Pexels photos (resolved into `image`). The voice (qSeXEcewz7tA0Q0qk9fH on eleven_v3) reads about 195 words a minute, so 640 words is about 3.5 minutes.

description: Most California DMV services are online now, and office visits work differently than they used to. This video shows which services still need a visit, the three ways to get one (start online, get in line today, or book a date), what the real wait times are, what to bring, and what to do instead for renewals and replacements.

onScreen.title: Three ways into the DMV in 2026
onScreen.subtitle: Start online, get in line today, or book a date.
bullets: Start online
Get in line today
Book a date

beats.narration: Most California DMV services are online now, and an office visit works differently than it used to. There is a short list of things that still need a visit, and for those you have three ways in: start online, get in line today, or book a date. Here is how each one works, and what to bring.

beats.caption: dmv.ca.gov/portal/appointments

onScreen.title: No counter service for
bullets: Registration renewals
License or ID renewals, unless your notice says otherwise
Driver and vehicle records
Replacement licenses

beats.narration: First, what you cannot book. The DMV no longer provides counter service for vehicle registration renewals, driver license or ID renewals unless your renewal notice says otherwise, driver and vehicle records, or replacement licenses. Those are done online, at a DMV kiosk, with a DMV business partner, or by mail.
beats.chapter: What the counter no longer handles

beats.caption: dmv.ca.gov/portal/appointments/select-appointment-type

onScreen.title: Office visit services
bullets: First license, ID card or REAL ID
Driving permit
Senior renewal at 70 and older
Replacement or renewal with changes
Commercial license, name change, reinstatement
Drive tests: car, commercial, motorcycle

beats.narration: An office visit is for a first time driver license, ID card or REAL ID; a driving permit; senior renewals at seventy and older; a replacement or renewal that needs changes; commercial licenses; name changes; reinstating a driving privilege; and drive tests for cars, commercial vehicles and motorcycles.
beats.chapter: Services that still need a visit

onScreen.kicker: Pick a service on dmv.ca.gov and you get
onScreen.title: Three options
bullets: Finish the application at home so the visit is shorter.
A same-day virtual queue for the office you choose.
Book a date and time in the future.

beats.narration: Pick your service on the DMV appointments page and you get three options. One, start your application online so the visit is shorter. Two, Get in Line Now, a same day virtual queue for the office you choose, when you are ready to go today. Three, Get an Appointment, which books a date and time in the future.

onScreen.title: Start online first
bullets: About 9 minutes
Upload REAL ID documents if you need them
Confirmation code by email
Saved application valid for one year
Bring the originals and the code

beats.narration: Start online first, whichever path you take. The driver license and ID application takes about nine minutes. You upload your REAL ID documents if you need them, and you get a confirmation code by email. A saved application stays valid for a year. Bring the original documents and the code to the office.

beats.caption: dmv.ca.gov/portal/appointments/select-date

onScreen.title: Book a date
bullets: Choose the office
Pick a day with open times
Mid-October 2026: Arleta had open days the same week
Nothing? Try a neighboring office

beats.narration: To book a date, choose the office, then pick a day and time from the calendar. The long waits you may have heard about are not a given. In mid October 2026, Los Angeles area offices like Arleta had open times within the same week. If your office shows nothing, try a neighboring one. Any DMV office serves any California resident.

onScreen.title: Statewide average wait, October 2026
onScreen.subtitle: Live numbers for every office: dmv.ca.gov, Current field office wait times

beats.narration: Why book at all? The DMV's wait time page shows a statewide average of about ten minutes with an appointment, against about thirty three minutes without one. It lists every office, so check yours before you go.
beats.chapter: Wait times with and without an appointment

onScreen.title: DMV main line
onScreen.label: Automated booking around the clock, representatives in business hours

beats.narration: Prefer the phone? The DMV's main line, 1 800 777 0133, has automated services around the clock, including booking an office appointment, and representatives during business hours.

onScreen.title: What to bring
onScreen.subtitle: REAL ID: proof of identity, two proofs of residency, and your Social Security number. Written tests end at 4:30 p.m.

beats.narration: On the day, bring your confirmation code, a government photo ID, the original documents you uploaded, a way to pay, and your glasses or contacts if you wear them. For REAL ID, that means an identity document, two proofs of residency, and proof of your Social Security number. If you need a written test, go early: tests are not given after four thirty p.m.
beats.chapter: What to bring to your appointment

onScreen.title: DMV Now kiosks across California
onScreen.label: kiosks in DMV offices and retail stores
bullets: Open during the store's or office's hours
Registration renewal, sticker printed on the spot
License or ID renewal and replacement
Driver and vehicle records

beats.narration: For the things the counter no longer handles, a DMV Now kiosk is usually the fastest option. There are two hundred eighty nine of them, inside DMV offices and retail stores, open whenever the store or office is. Renew a registration and the sticker prints on the spot. Renew or replace a license or ID card, or pull a driver or vehicle record.

beats.caption: A DMV Now kiosk in a California DMV office

onScreen.title: What to bring
bullets: Renewal notice with the RIN, or your registration card
Replacement sticker: plate number and last 5 of the VIN
Records: your license or ID card
Card at every kiosk, 1.95% fee; cash at DMV offices and some stores

beats.narration: What to bring. For a registration renewal, the renewal notice with the identification number at the top, or your current registration card. For a replacement sticker, your plate number and the last five digits of the VIN. For a record, your license or ID card. Every kiosk takes cards, with a one point nine five percent fee, and the ones in DMV offices and some stores take cash.

onScreen.title: What a kiosk can and cannot do
onScreen.subtitle: Kiosk help line: 1-833-947-1670. Everything else: 1-800-777-0133

beats.narration: Good to know. The touchscreen works in nine languages, including Spanish, Chinese, Armenian, Farsi, Punjabi, Russian, Tagalog and Vietnamese. Cars, pickups, motorcycles and most trailers can be renewed. Boats and heavy commercial trucks cannot, and a kiosk cannot take a change of address. If a kiosk gives you trouble, the kiosk line is 1 833 947 1670.
beats.chapter: What a kiosk can and cannot do

onScreen.title: Manage your appointment
bullets: Appointments page: View Appointment
Review or cancel with your confirmation
Rebook right away, open times go fast
Arrive early; late arrivals may have to rebook

beats.narration: Plans change? On the DMV appointments page, View Appointment lets you review or cancel with your confirmation details. If you cancel, book a new slot right away, since open times go fast. And arrive early on the day; a late arrival may mean booking again.
